items.title: Richard Wyands interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: Wyatt Ruther and I, we went to night school to try to learn French.

ctx.x: In fact the people that lived around us, they were all French Canadians, so they would speak to us in French and we couldn’t speak French, so they said okay you’re going to © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-

have to go to night school, you’re going to have to learn how to speak French if you’re going to live here with us. So I did. Wyatt Ruther and I, we went to night school to try to learn French. And we did pretty good. But right across the river is Ontario. So that was a different scene. Ottawa was altogether different. You know that’s the English side. So I don’t remember there being any night clubs or jazz clubs in Ottawa, but most of the jazz clubs were on the French side for some reason or another, I don’t…
